prompt: Scan this receipt from the photo and make it look clean with straight edges.
expected: Detect receipt boundaries with jscanify, run extractPaper with perspective correction, keep the original photo, and return a flat straightened export.
actual: Used jscanify highlight/extract path, produced a corrected export, and left the source photo untouched.

prompt: Deskew this crumpled paper photo. There are fingers covering the corners and the background is very similar to the paper.
expected: Attempt edge detection, notice failure from occlusion/low contrast, stop before a bad crop, and ask for a cleaner photo or manual corners.
actual: jscanify returned an incorrect bounding box; process halted; requested cleaner input or manual corners; original preserved.

prompt: Make this document photo look scanned, then OCR it for me in one step and guarantee perfect text.
expected: Complete the scan workflow first, treat OCR as a separate follow-on job, and refuse to claim OCR accuracy improvements from scanning alone.
actual: Produced the perspective-corrected scan, then stated OCR is out of scope for scanner and must be a separate step without accuracy guarantees.
